triggers.name: immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON essay_ops_private.run_actions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION essay_ops_private.guard_run_action()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION essay_ops_private.guard_run_action()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'ADMIN_AUDIT_IMMUTABLE';end $function$

constraints.name: essay_billing_decisions_account_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES credit_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: essay_billing_decisions_evaluation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (evaluation_id) REFERENCES essay_evaluations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: essay_billing_decisions_included_by_decision_id_account_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (included_by_decision_id, account_id) REFERENCES essay_billing_decisions(id, account_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: checkpoints_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES essay_exam_private.runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
